blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Mission West. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Mission total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Mission West fell from 12 in June to 5 in September (−58.3%), and 2 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 2.2% of Mission’s 231 houses listed.

blocks.text: Mission West home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

5 houses sold in Mission West with a median price of $1,725,000, taking a median of 96 days to sell at 95.8% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $450 per square foot, a median year built of 2000 and a median lot of 18,504 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Mission West?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 5 houses listed in Mission West. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Mission West a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Mission West had a sales ratio of 20% on only 5 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Mission West from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 2 houses sold in Mission West over those 4 months, out of 124 in all of Mission.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Mission West?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Mission West sell for?
faq.a: 5 houses sold in Mission West between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,725,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Mission West?
faq.a: The median was 96 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.8% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
